name: GRUT-M1-W: explicit autonomous writing apparatus
reason: The core M1 retention/readout test passed, but its separately registered local-bit and autonomous-writing attacks failed. Complete its preparation obligation with a separately named, physically modeled apparatus. Do not relabel this as formation without prepared resources.
architecture_change_budget: One completion only: same M1 Hamiltonian and parameters, plus a source qubit and a massive quantum particle. No tuning of the memory Hamiltonian, no further repair loop.
hilbert_space: L^2(R_Q) tensor C^2_source tensor (C^2_sigma tensor C^2_tau)^(tensor L)
total_hamiltonian: P^2/(2M) + H_M1 + Omega (1-R_z)/2 sum_i f_i(Q) tau_i^x
gate_shape: f_i(Q)=cos^2(pi(Q-i)/(2w)) for abs(Q-i)<w and zero otherwise; integral f_i dQ=w
preparation: source R_z=+1 or -1 at equal prior; all tau initially +z for both inputs; sigma all +z except sigma_1 in +x; Gaussian clock packet centered q0,p0 with position probability variance sigma_q^2. The source bit, blank register, carrier energy and matter preparation are supplied resources.
physical_claim: A source bit is copied into a repetitive memory register by a moving quantum apparatus under one time-independent Hamiltonian, then affects a matter-spin readout. No external pulse, reset, postselection, reservoir or time-dependent physical coupling.

numerics.method: unitary symmetric split of clock kinetic FFT, M1 local diagonal/rotation terms, and position-dependent writer rotations; compare refinements and report energy drift, edge and spectral-tail weights
numerics.after_scattering: trace over the clock without conditioning on transmission; propagate the full spin density matrix with the original exact M1 spectrum. Interpret storage numbers with the stated finite scattering-domain and residual-interaction qualifications.

acceptance.write_and_hold: equal-prior tau_0^z guessing success >=0.9 at every sampled storage time through 10, starting from identical blank tau registers
acceptance.all_cells: all individual tau_i^z guessing successes >=0.9 immediately after the scattering stage; record their later minima
acceptance.readout: matter sigma_1^y guessing success exceeds 0.6 in [0,2], with memory success >=0.9 at that time
acceptance.unitarity: norm error below 1e-9; preserve both transmitted and reflected components in the clock trace
acceptance.refinement: probabilities at the two time steps differ by <=0.01 and total energy drift differs by <=0.1 in spin energy units; otherwise refine once or report unresolved
acceptance.scattering_limits: report the clock probability remaining near any gate and all numerical boundary/spectral weights. Do not claim a rigorous infinite-time decoupling theorem or erase this approximation.
acceptance.resource_account: report initial/final clock, spin, interaction and total energies. The energy source and input bit are explicit; no creation from nothing.
acceptance.gravity: no horizon, graviton amplitude or gravitational Lyapunov exponent is computed. A working apparatus is not a theory of all physics.
